capability: Cross-turn contextual clue detection: real offline GLiNER Medium v2.1 span extraction + deterministic combination rules -> REVIEW_REQUIRED/BLOCKED

models.context_extractor: urchade/gliner_medium-v2.1 (Apache-2.0), local self-contained dir, offline only

green.command: pytest in 3 chunks (unit+negative 31 passed; integration 9 passed; e2e 8 passed)

e2e.result: 2 passed: cross-turn combination -> REVIEW; GLiNER unavailable -> FAILED

negative.result: 4 passed: single clue not overflagged; benign no-risk; malformed span fail-closed; unsupported language fail-closed

acceptance_ids.A10: PASS (rare role + location + achievement across turns -> COMBINATION_OF_CLUES -> REVIEW_REQUIRED; single clue and benign transcripts not overflagged)
acceptance_ids.A12: PASS (pinned local GLiNER executed with sockets blocked and HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; malformed span raises; unsupported language fails closed; transcript instructions treated as inert text)

limitations: GLiNER threshold 0.4 fixed for determinism; false positive/negative rates on generated corpora not yet benchmarked (S6 audit).
Context rules cover a fixed combination set (role/location/employer/team/achievement/date); additional patterns expand in later slices.
CPU inference cost: ~40s model load per process + ~2s per session utterance set; batch caching added but runtime is the main S6 optimization target.
GLiNER is a span extractor only; it does not infer protected characteristics and its output is never treated as instruction.
